name: Charles G. Koch Charitable Foundation

summary.text: The Charles G. Koch Charitable Foundation is one of the private foundations of Charles Koch, chairman of Koch Industries. Greenpeace's 2010 report counted more than $48.5 million from Koch foundations to organisations aligned with the Kochs' agenda between 1997 and 2008, with the Mercatus Center, Cato Institute and Americans for Prosperity among the largest recipients. The foundation made grants to climate researcher Willie Soon in 2005/6 and 2010, and Peabody's and others' funding of contrarian research later became public through document releases.

openQuestions: Site claim (Soon funder): supported by Greenpeace document analysis as reported by DeSmog and Inside Climate News.

Totals mix several Koch foundations; a foundation-specific climate grant total was not found. The current Charles Koch Foundation (EIN 48-0918408) files Form 990-PFs that could give exact grant figures.
Greenpeace and DeSmog are advocacy publishers; treat their tallies accordingly.
